blocks.text: New Year VIP tour of Brazil with Bonito: Rio and Iguazu | 16 days

blocks.text: This 16-day journey combines Rio de Janeiro, Iguazu Falls, the clear rivers and caves of Bonito, and the beaches of Pernambuco. Celebrate New Year on Copacabana after a VIP dinner at Belmond, then leave the city for waterfalls, underground lakes, forest trails and snorkelling in the Rio Sucuri. Spend the final days at Nannai Muro Alto beside the warm ocean and natural pools behind the reef.
